note: Demo-seed fidelity manifest (#2063). One entry per screen that only looks
alive when the demo seed puts rows behind it. `model` is a Prisma model name
(delegate resolution is case-insensitive, and a name that is not in the
schema is a hard error — a typo here must never be a silent pass).
minRows  = the ENFORCED floor. A count below it fails the build. It is set to
what prisma/seed-demo.mjs actually produces today, so the gate is a
ratchet: coverage can go up, never quietly back down.
target   = how many rows the screen needs to stop reading as empty.
issue    = who owns closing the gap when minRows < target.
When minRows < target the row is reported as PENDING with its issue on every
run, so the debt is visible instead of dropped. DEMO_FIDELITY_STRICT=1 makes
the checker enforce `target` too — use it while working on a coverage issue,
then raise minRows to the new count in the same PR.
How to add a screen: docs/testing.md, 'Demo-seed fidelity gate'.
